international.title: Elon Musk joins 158,000 others calling for Nvidia to bring back Jensen Huang in open letter
international.summary: Silicon Valley figures back CEO ousted after revelations of affair with suspected Chinese spy, as US treasury secretary urges Nvidia to carry out ‘dramatic shake-up’ Elon Musk and a host of other tech executives are among more than 158,000 signatories of an open letter calling for Jensen Huang’s reinstatement as Nvidia chief, days after he resigned from the multi-trillion dollar chip company. The letter demands that the company’s board members “bring Jensen back while an independent investigation establishes the facts”. Continue reading...

international.title: Czechs rally against gov’t threat to media independence
